title: The Forgotten
move_pattern: Cycles between Miasma and Dread. Starts with Miasma.
notes: Dread damage scales with the monster's Dexterity power—each use of Miasma steals 2 Dexterity from the player and applies 2 to the monster, making subsequent Dread attacks progressively more dangerous. The monster begins combat with Possess Speed, increasing its action speed.
